items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX joins the Nasdaq 100, clearing way for potential investment influx. Here's what to know - ABC News
items.source: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
items.summary_cn: SpaceX加入纳斯达克100指数，为潜在资金流入铺路，重大利好SPCH(SpaceX杠杆ETF)持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk can’t sell a single SpaceX share for a year—and then all the locks crack open at once
items.summary_cn: Musk一年内不能出售任何SpaceX股份，锁定期满后所有限制同时解除，揭示SPCH持仓标的的解禁与流动性风险。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX valuations are a bit 'fantastical,' even if Elon Musk can put data centers in space
items.summary_cn: 媒体质疑SpaceX估值'幻想化'，即使太空数据中心概念也难支撑，对SPCH持仓偏负面。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Even Fervent Musk Fans Should Worry About the SpaceX Governance Risks
items.summary_cn: 媒体警示SpaceX治理风险，质疑Musk帝国治理结构，对SPCH(SpaceX杠杆ETF)持仓偏负面信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's xAI is now officially called SpaceXAI
items.summary_cn: Musk的xAI正式更名为SpaceXAI，整合AI与航天业务，SPCH(SpaceX杠杆ETF)持仓间接受关注。

items.author: Musk
items.text: XAI makes its rebrand to SpaceXAI complete with a new logo
items.summary_cn: xAI完成更名SpaceXAI并发布新logo，强化航天+AI叙事，SPCH持仓间接受关注。

items.author: Trump
items.summary_cn: Trump发文宣称油价下跌，附带沙特大幅降价报道，对能源板块偏多；金风科技(02208)作为新能源持仓间接受益油价回落。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk and Tesla announce serious AI changes for workers
items.summary_cn: Musk与Tesla宣布员工层面AI变革，涉Tesla/电动车AI应用，与MSFU(微软杠杆ETF)同属AI板块间接相关。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Toyota is moving from Mexico to the United States (Texas!). A really big deal. Tariffs at work! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump称丰田从墨西哥迁至美国德州，归功于关税政策，体现制造业回流主题。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Fed Reserve working paper suggests Biden illegal immigrant wave drove up home prices 30%: https://justthenews.com/government/security/fed-reserve-working-paper-suggests-biden-illegal-immigrant-wave-drove-home
items.summary_cn: Trump转Fed工作论文称Biden时期非法移民推高房价30%，暗示当前政策纠偏有利于房价，对房地产/利率板块有间接影响。

items.author: Musk
items.text: What will define Elon Musk’s legacy? Doge cuts to USAID Ebola programs
items.summary_cn: Musk主导的DOGE削减USAID埃博拉项目等预算，涉政府支出与公共健康板块。
